description: Reads the motor and three inverter temperature channels from the application sensors.

outputPorts.name: T_Motor
outputPorts.description: Motor temperature in degrees Celsius; NaN indicates a disabled or invalid sensor.

outputPorts.name: T_Inv1
outputPorts.description: Inverter temperature channel 1 in degrees Celsius; NaN indicates an invalid sensor.

outputPorts.name: T_Inv2
outputPorts.description: Inverter temperature channel 2 in degrees Celsius; NaN indicates an invalid sensor.

outputPorts.name: T_Inv3
outputPorts.description: Inverter temperature channel 3 in degrees Celsius; NaN indicates an invalid sensor.
